isolation_compliance.note: This assessment relies exclusively on the four authorized final artifacts.

object_reports.concrete_reason: The desk is aligned at the east wall and the chair is directly opposite it on the room side. The rendered work-use and chair pull-out zones remain open, and the validator confirms collision-free reachable desk access.
The chair is close enough to serve the desk without occupying the door route, and its dedicated pull-out/standing clearance is unobstructed in the visualization and validation report.
The bookcase is wall-aligned at the north side, away from the window opening, with a clear front-facing browsing zone and a reachable access target.
The cabinet is placed along the south wall clear of the entry opening, and its front operation zone and access target are both unobstructed and reachable.

The armchair forms a distinct, angled reading position near the window. Its side table and floor lamp are nearby without encroaching on the chair approach zone or the window clearance, and reading access is validated.
The compact side table is positioned beside the reading seat as a usable support surface while preserving a visible gap and the seat's approach clearance.
The floor lamp is within practical reach of the reading chair, remains outside the chair approach area, and does not block the circulation path from the door.
